justification: Both are relief-carved surfaces covered with dense ornament including bands of repeated motifs and a radiating circular element (the spoked wheel in B, the rosette-like discs and headdress volutes in A), but that is essentially generic. A depicts a frontal standing human figure in elaborate regalia with a mask-like face at centre, while B depicts a spoked wheel below a lattice-patterned panel with no human figure, so the subject matter and relationships differ fundamentally.
